title: Settings
subtitle: Organisation profile, regional formats, attendance, synchronisation, notifications, security and subscription.

general.title: Organisation profile
general.hint: Names shown across the app and on reports.

regional.title: Region & language
regional.hint: The organisation timezone is the default for branches and for dates shown in the app.
regional.weeklyOffHint: Default for branches and employees without their own setting.
regional.formatsHint: How dates and times are displayed.

attendance.title: Attendance processing
attendance.hint: Defaults for the attendance engine. Detailed rules live in attendance rule sets.
attendance.defaultShiftHint: Used when no shift is assigned to an employee.
attendance.processingDelayHint: Wait after a punch before recalculating the day, to batch bursts of punches.
attendance.cutoffDayHint: 1–28, used when the period is a custom cut-off.
attendance.selfServiceHint: Employees with a linked user can request corrections to their own attendance.

sync.title: Device synchronisation
sync.hint: Polling cadence and automatic pushes. Device-specific overrides live on each device.
sync.offlineThresholdHint: Minutes without contact before a device is marked offline.
sync.reconciliationHint: Full comparison of device users vs. employees.
sync.adaptiveHint: Poll more often during busy hours and back off when idle.
sync.autoPushHint: Queue a device push when an employee is created or changed.
sync.maxSkewHint: Punches with a larger device clock skew are quarantined.

notifications.title: Organisation notifications
notifications.hint: Which events create in-app notifications for administrators.
notifications.syncFailedHint: A sync job or item failed after retries.
notifications.approvalPendingHint: A correction or leave request awaits approval.
notifications.dailyDigestHint: One summary per day instead of individual alerts.

security.title: Security policy
security.hint: Applies to every member of this organisation.
security.mfaRequiredHint: Members without MFA are blocked from the API until they enrol.
security.exportReasonHint: Exports of employee data must include a reason (audited).
security.domainsHint: Comma-separated. Leave empty to allow any domain for invitations.

mfa.title: Your two-factor authentication
mfa.hint: Protect your own account with an authenticator app (TOTP).
mfa.noneHint: Add an authenticator to require a 6-digit code at sign-in.
mfa.scan: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the secret manually, then type the 6-digit code.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
mfa.removeHint: If your organisation requires MFA you will need to enrol again before using the app.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.hint: Plan, status and limits for this organisation. Changes are handled by FlowZa support.
subscription.unavailable: Subscription details are not available here yet
subscription.unavailableHint: Your organisation is {{status}}. Contact support for plan details.
subscription.limitsHint: Usage against the limits of your plan.
